incidents.summary: Financial inheritance exposed that BINDING_POLICY still restated the retired 2.3 same-owner/cross-scope-handoff mutation semantics while AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY had already promoted hierarchical parent governance.

UAOS still retained domains/financial_writing manifest/policy/workflow files after SYSTEM_MAP and AGENT_REGISTRY cut current Financial business authority over to the external financial-writing-agent repository.

root_cause: Two migration-era copies outlived their ownership boundary: BINDING_POLICY duplicated mutation semantics owned by AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY, and the parent repository retained a Financial business workflow package after external cutover.

changes: Make BINDING_POLICY delegate mutation hierarchy exclusively to AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY while retaining binding/compatibility admission.
Retire the parent domains/financial_writing business package without removing the reusable Domain SDK.
Replace the old parent Financial workflow test with external-authority uniqueness and binding-policy ownership tests.
proposal.rollback_plan: Do not promote candidate if full UAOS CI regresses; parent main remains unchanged until evaluated CAS promotion.

required: no current Financial in-repo business package
Financial external binding uniqueness test PASS
